commit.subject: LU-20390 dbg: debug sanity-sec test_54 - 3
commit.message:
LU-20390 dbg: debug sanity-sec test_54 - 3

Now that the crypto.c fix keeps .fscrypt resolvable by plaintext
regardless of the key state, the dentry should no longer be
invalidated when the key loads - which was presumably the event
detaching the subtree in the first place.
So the extra cleanup in ll_put_super() might not be necessary after
all.
